notes:
Top-line: Emberfield (product analytics SaaS) — mid-market (250 engs + PMs). Evaluating Redwood as replacement for CurrentVendor API. Primary motivation: unit-cost + predictable latency during peak inference and better controls for fallbacks. They want to start on Hosted to validate parity, then move to Dedicated reserve pool for predictable throughput.

Key contacts: CTO Priya Nair (security owner), Head of ML Ops: Luca Romano, Product lead: Danika Ortiz. AE: Jordan Patel. SE: Maya Chen. CSM: Alejandro Ruiz (pre-assigned if move to Dedicated).

Use-case snapshot:
- Customer-facing chat assistant embedded in app (session-based; long context recall via embeddings)
- Semantic search/embeddings for docs (re-ranking 1k candidates per request), background summarization jobs
- Need reranking pipeline for search results with 75ms p99 for reranker; chat latency target 150-250ms p95 (EU region)

Migration specifics discussed:
- Compatibility layer required: CurrentVendor uses different function-calling schema and tokenization. We proposed a compat-shim (sample provided, drive:/Shared/migrations/compat-shim-sample.js).
- Prompt parity risks: observed paraphrase/regression on 7% of test prompts in initial run (differences tied to stop-sequence handling and sampling seeds). SE workstream to add normalization + deterministic sampling in POC.
- Tokenization delta: ~3% token count increase vs CurrentVendor for multilingual prompts (affects cost model). Quantization/ops on Dedicated expected to reduce per-token cost by 30-40% in projection.
- KV cache + batching: recommended batch size 8 for their traffic profile; Redwood suggested prefix caching for session histories to save tokens.
- Function calling: mapping layer for CurrentVendor->Redwood function schema included; edge cases: nested arguments and binary attachments.

Security/compliance:
- Must have SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration; DPA under legal review. Data residency: customer primary EU-customer base — need EU region residency guarantee for Dedicated.

POC plan (agreed):
1) 14-day Hosted POC (EU region) — run parity suite (2k prompts) + heavy tail latency tests, cost baseline.
2) Collect eval metrics: token counts, per-route latency, regressions, semantic score deltas for reranker.
3) Post-POC: sizing workshop for Dedicated (2x A100 equiv nodes initial), pricing for 12-month commit vs pay-as-you-go.
4) Migration doc + runbook delivery (Redwood to supply checklist + compat-shim examples).
